title: Safari Native Binding and macOS Release-Operations Convergence — X4 Audit
summary: Lane X4 closes the Safari native messaging binding milestone identified by S4 and establishes the macOS release-operations application boundary. All five S4 integration deeds are completed: N1 contract now registers all 8 Q0 message kinds, payload model widened to typed discriminants, direction field added, response emission implemented for all 4 response kinds, created_at with sent_at alias. The native message handler (SafariExtensionHost) validates, dispatches, and responds to all Q0-compatible messages with content-light enforcement. The macOS release-operations boundary includes: .app packaging with build script, codesign preparation with entitlements, notarization preparation with notarytool evidence, Sparkle 2 update delivery contract, recovery orchestration surface, and content-light diagnostic export service. 52 Swift tests and 37 Python tests pass. 6 new schemas created. App builds from SPM with clean compilation.

verdict.statement: All five S4 integration deeds are completed. N1 contract fully implements Q0 protocol with typed payloads, direction field, response emission, and timestamp alias. The SafariExtensionHost provides a real message handler with content-light enforcement, origin validation, and Q0-compatible response emission. Swift tests validate all 8 message kinds, integer payload fields, direction enforcement, and refusal paths. The protocol is convergent — no redesign needed.

claim_adversary_results.attack_canonical_evidence_reconstruction: PASS — 6 schemas created. Swift tests prove roundtrip. Python models validate.
claim_adversary_results.attack_lane_boundary_release_safety: PASS — only X4-owned files modified. Frontend, desktop gateway, PostgreSQL, Repository Estate, Timeline, Publication all preserved.
claim_adversary_results.attack_privacy_guards: PASS — content-light enforcement in Swift (token patterns, forbidden keys) and Python (token scanning, redaction). No credentials in code.
claim_adversary_results.attack_refusal_behavior: PASS — origin mismatch, direction mismatch, content-light violations all produce typed refusal responses.
claim_adversary_results.attack_no_false_claims: PASS — signing/notarization claims explicitly gated by credential availability. Sparkle integration documented but not yet implemented at SwiftUI app level. Xcode project requirement explicitly blocked.
